items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...He played with, he played with Jolly Gallimore. [INTERVIEWEE] They had so many.

ctx.x: Did you make any of these names? No, no, no. He played with, he played with Jolly Gallimore.
They had so many. Just like this little fellow, Ones, what you call him, Ones. Plays up there with Rubble or something like that.
